input.content: Idempotency/recovery record key mismatch (P1 pattern): a recovery record stored under operation_id (`store.recovery[operation_id] = record`) but looked up by a different attribute (e.g. scanning `recovery.values()` for a matching workspace). Effect: any fresh operation ID for an entity that already has a record reuses the old record, skips apply, re-receipts the old operation, and returns success under the new ID — silent lost updates and missing audit records. Check: lookup key must equal the storage key (`recovery.get(operation_id)`); responses should come from the record actually receipted, not from the call arguments. Seen in service.py save recovery update (2026-10-11).
